graticule_geology: The 2011 sheet's graticule, kept as a QA reference for the scan's fit. 22 features, EPSG:4326. QA object, not geography: do not map it as features.
graticule_minerals: The 2023 sheet's graticule, kept as a QA reference for that scan's fit. 11 features, EPSG:4326. QA object, not geography: do not map it as features.
raster_dem: Georeferenced scan: Digital Elevation Model of Nigeria (elevation, 7 classes, metres), 2000x1415 px at 0.97 x 1.00 km/px, EPSG:4326 RGBA tiles; land-border offset 4.1 km (N/S/W/E -1.7/+9.8/-4.1/-2.7), overlap with the territory 0.958. This is a picture of an elevation map with hillshading - read elevation from a real DEM. Legend in RASTER_LAYERS.md.
raster_soil_ph: Georeferenced scan: Soil pH distribution in Nigeria (soil pH, 5 classes), 2000x1415 px at 1.02 x 1.03 km/px, EPSG:4326 RGBA tiles; land-border offset 4.7 km (N/S/W/E -3.2/-0.9/-4.1/-3.7), overlap with the territory 0.970. This is a 1:2,000,000 print with no source citation - class edges are drawn by hand, not surveyed. Legend in RASTER_LAYERS.md.
raster_temperature: Georeferenced scan: Nigeria historical average temperature, Jan-Dec 1986-2015 (mean temperature, 13 classes, degrees C), 816x1056 px at 1.84 x 1.87 km/px, EPSG:4326 RGBA tiles; land-border offset 4.1 km (N/S/W/E -2.5/-4.5/-2.5/+1.4), overlap with the territory 0.975. This is CHIRTSmax Jan-Dec 1986-2015 climatology, one class is water - not a forecast, not a station record. Legend in RASTER_LAYERS.md.
raster_forest_reserves: Georeferenced scan: Forest reserves and major rivers of Nigeria (forest reserves / major rivers / water), 6600x5100 px at 0.22 x 0.22 km/px, EPSG:4326 RGBA tiles; land-border offset 10.4 km (N/S/W/E -1.9/-3.8/+0.3/+4.5), overlap with the territory 0.852. This is a reserves-and-rivers map, not forest cover; the noisiest fit of the nine. Legend in RASTER_LAYERS.md.
raster_landcover: Georeferenced scan: Land cover of Nigeria (land cover, 15 classes), 609x510 px at 3.05 x 3.04 km/px, EPSG:4326 RGBA tiles; land-border offset 3.7 km (N/S/W/E -2.0/-4.8/-3.1/+1.0), overlap with the territory 0.984. This is the coarsest sheet (3 km/px, 15 classes) - a locator, not a land-cover dataset. Legend in RASTER_LAYERS.md.
raster_population: Georeferenced scan: Population distribution of Nigeria (population by district, 5 classes (absolute)), 850x520 px at 2.37 x 2.32 km/px, EPSG:4326 RGBA tiles; land-border offset 10.9 km (N/S/W/E -8.7/+5.3/-25.0/-11.9), overlap with the territory 0.928. This is absolute counts per unnamed district - do not join to admin layers or normalise by area; position is approximate. Legend in RASTER_LAYERS.md.
raster_ethnic_groups: Georeferenced scan: Ethno-linguistic groups of Nigeria (ethno-linguistic groups, 35 classes), 1344x1344 px at 1.36 x 1.38 km/px, EPSG:4326 RGBA tiles; land-border offset 4.7 km (N/S/W/E -2.5/-3.3/-4.0/-4.2), overlap with the territory 0.949. This is schematic: boundaries indicative, close colours deliberately encode close languages. Legend in RASTER_LAYERS.md.
raster_dominant_soils: Georeferenced scan: Dominant soils of Nigeria (dominant soil unit, ~60 classes (FAO/UNESCO)), 10234x6678 px at 0.17 x 0.17 km/px, EPSG:4326 RGBA tiles; land-border offset 4.1 km (N/S/W/E -1.3/+3.7/-2.6/-9.3), overlap with the territory 0.891. This is the five inset panels on the right were clipped away, so the layer is the main map alone. Legend in RASTER_LAYERS.md.
raster_general_geology: Georeferenced scan: General geology of Nigeria (simplified) (geology, simplified to 9 classes by era), 615x715 px at 2.47 x 2.81 km/px, EPSG:4326 RGBA tiles; land-border offset 4.7 km (N/S/W/E -3.1/+3.9/-5.6/-8.0), overlap with the territory 0.965. This is a simplification of the geology already shipped as `geology_units`; use `geology_era` for the class areas. Legend in RASTER_LAYERS.md.
minerals_named: The 1,323 printed symbols that were named and anchored, good to about 0.35 km. 1,323 features, EPSG:4326.
state_capitals: State capitals named on the sheet, as label centres - 32 of the 37 (36 states plus the FCT). 32 features, EPSG:4326. Label centres: good to about 15 km, not city-centre coordinates. Abuja, Owerri, Yenagoa, Abeokuta and Osogbo are not labelled here (nor in `towns`); take them from `towns_geonames`.
volcanic_plugs: Volcanic plugs and necks as points. 68 features, EPSG:4326.
towns_geonames: The gazetteer: every populated place GeoNames records for Nigeria, with state and population where known; built by build_towns.py from the GeoNames allCountries dump (CC BY 4.0, 2014-10-02 snapshot). 45,415 features, EPSG:4326. Names and coordinates are GeoNames'. `coord_dp` gives the decimal places GeoNames recorded: 7,372 entries carry 2 or fewer, i.e. a position good to about 1 km at best and 50 km at worst - filter on it before measuring distances. 642 rows are a second spelling of a place already in the layer (`dup_group`) and 2,638 share an exact coordinate with another row. 98.9 % fall inside the border. See towns_geonames.md.
mineral_symbols: Minerals read off the printed symbols, 1,609 points, with the printed commodity attributes. 1,609 features, EPSG:4326. Positions withdrawn: the symbol centres are not reliable. Attributes are usable, geometry is not.
mineral_localities: Raw extraction of mineral localities (999 points). 999 features, EPSG:4326. Positions withdrawn - do not use the coordinates.
mineral_localities_refined: The same 999 localities under the older snapping policy. 999 features, EPSG:4326. Positions withdrawn - do not use the coordinates.
mineral_localities_utm32n: EPSG:32632 copy of `mineral_localities_refined`, not of `mineral_localities` - the name is historic and the contents are the refined positions (they differ from the raw extraction by up to 11.9 km in 117 of 999 rows). 999 features, EPSG:32632. Positions withdrawn - the projection does not fix them.
mineral_localities_icons: The same 999 localities, anchored to the printed icons. 999 features, EPSG:4326. Positions withdrawn - do not use the coordinates.
mineral_localities_icons_utm32n: `mineral_localities_icons` in EPSG:32632. 999 features, EPSG:32632. Positions withdrawn - the projection does not fix them.
mineral_localities_equal_area: `mineral_localities_icons` in EPSG:6933 - the icon-anchored layer, not the raw extraction. 999 features, EPSG:6933. Positions withdrawn - the projection does not fix them.
towns: Settlements as printed on the 2011 sheet, with their host geology unit, and labels placed where the sheet places them. `lon`/`lat` (6 dp, about 0.1 m) are the same point as the geometry. 486 features, EPSG:4326. Label centres, not surveyed coordinates; 82 rows have no name because the printed label could not be read - for coverage use `towns_geonames`.
state_boundaries: The 36 state boundaries plus the FCT, as lines. 83 features, EPSG:4326.
fold_axes: Anticline and syncline axes as lines. 90 features, EPSG:4326. Axes, not fold limbs.
roads: Trunk roads as lines from the source map. 122 features, EPSG:4326.
rivers: Drainage centrelines from the source map. 1,054 features, EPSG:4326. 83 % of their length is inside Nigeria; they continue across the border.
faults: Major and inferred faults as lines. 648 features, EPSG:4326. Inferred faults are drawn, not observed.
geology_boundaries: Geological contacts as lines, with a confidence attribute. 2,819 features, EPSG:4326. Not the same object as `international_boundary`.
younger_granite_outlines: Outlines of the Jos Plateau ring complexes (younger granites) as lines. 59 features, EPSG:4326. Outlines only: no polygon fill is implied.
railway: Rail lines as lines from the source map. 6 features, EPSG:4326.
international_boundary: The 2023 land border as printed on the source map, one line; every geology vertex is within 7.5 m of it. 1 feature, EPSG:4326.
national_territory: Nigeria's national territory, the polygon every layer is clipped to (2023 border, EPSG:4326). 1 feature, EPSG:4326.
geology_units: The geology: 96 rock units plus water, no overlaps and no gaps, attributed with era, period, lithology and age; built by build_geology_final.py. 97 features, EPSG:4326. A generalised 1:2,000,000 source: boundaries are good to a few km, not to a drill hole.
geology_units_utm32n: `geology_units` in EPSG:32632 (UTM 32N, metres) for metric work. 97 features, EPSG:32632. UTM area is +0.19 % over the true area; use equal-area for areas.
geology_units_equal_area: `geology_units` in EPSG:6933 (equal-area) with exact areas in `area_km2_equal_area`. 97 features, EPSG:6933.
geology_era: Seven era classes dissolved from the attributed `geology_units` vector (plus water and unclassified), keyed by `class_id`; built by build_vector_layers.py. Not a tracing of the general-geology sheet: that sheet's legend draws nine era-plus-lithology classes, so this is a coarser, era-only generalisation of the vector geology. 7 features, EPSG:4326.
poly_soil_ph: The soil-pH sheet as polygons: 5 pH classes traced from the printed fills, class colours measured from the printed swatches, clipped to the border; built by build_vector_layers.py. 111 features, EPSG:4326. Traced from a 1.02 km/px print, so class edges are good to about 1 km plus the sheet's own ~4 km registration error. The first legend swatch is printed in dark navy with no readable value and is kept as 'unlabelled' rather than guessed.
poly_population: The population sheet as polygons: 5 classes of absolute population by unnamed district, traced from the printed fills, clipped to the border; built by build_vector_layers.py. 299 features, EPSG:4326. Absolute counts per unnamed district on a 2.4 km/px print: not joinable to the admin layers and not normalisable by area. 7.5 % of the territory is left uncoloured on the sheet and is left uncoloured here.
water_bodies: Sea, Lake Chad and the Niger-Benue corridor as polygons, from the source map. 4 features, EPSG:4326. Deliberately not clipped to the territory: these run past the border and the sea is most of the area. Do not add to an area total.
